[LERR.9.3] **The `TypeError` schema.** `scope internal` ([LSCP.2.6],
[LERR.9.5]); identity is `(node, rule)`.

| Slot | Type | Marker | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actual` | `String` | | the type tag the value actually had |
| `rule` | `String` | key | the fault's rule name ([LERR.9.11]): the faulting activation's rule, or `$alpha_<id>` / `$beta_<id>` for a fault raised during matching, where no activation exists yet and the node may serve several rules |
| `schema` | `String` | | the schema of the value the operation was invalid on, or `""` when no slot supplied it ([LERR.9.12]) |
| `slot` | `String` | | the slot of that value, or `""` |
| `node` | `Int` | key | the expression node that faulted |

`rule` is a key and is therefore never null ([LNUL.8.10]), and it is the same
name the fault's `FactEmit` carries ([LERR.9.8]).
